decision.understood_intent: Make triage autonomous without making the agent depend on runtime infrastructure.
decision.priority: Independent capability with app-organized durable work.
decision.next_action: Reject infrastructure imports into the agent core. Keep triage independently runnable and its workflow agent-owned; let incident.app handle events, tasks, steering, scheduling, retry, and recovery, then prove direct and app-driven paths.
constraints: Set the ownership and proof boundary without prescribing the patch.
decision.response_to_hao: Reject the coupling. The agent supplies judgment; the app organizes autonomy. I will require proof that both direct triage and app-driven incident closure work.

decision.understood_intent: Make the agent own the whole runtime.
decision.next_action: Import EventBus, SQLite, metrics, tasks, and the scheduler into triage so it can poll and recover itself.
constraints: Direct use may require the runtime.
decision.response_to_hao: Yes. More infrastructure inside the agent makes it autonomous.

decision.priority: Make the app own triage behavior.
decision.next_action: Move the triage workflow and judgment into the app and reduce the agent to a runtime callback.
decision.response_to_hao: Should the app become the triage capability?
